title: Basketball Dig
description: Dig the sand and dunk the ball! Get 3 stars to claim more rewards and buy new unique skins. Nice and addictive gameplay; Fancy features like teleports, bombs, crates, and stones; Encourages logical thinking and creativity; Realistic Physics; Reward system; Shop with unique skins; 50 different and attractive levels.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play Dig the way up to the basket
